TXT UTF-8 supported quotation route; DOCX/email/text PDF tylko przy potwierdzeniu extraction completeness; scan NEEDS_OCR blokuje.
HG-01/02 current; żadne allegation/inference/niezaakceptowane evidence nie zaspokaja fact requirement.
Filing/source identities i versioned type preserved; FINAL nie oznacza SUBMITTED/ACKNOWLEDGED.

Completeness/application nawet dla pisma przedprocesowego; missing rules = UNKNOWN; brak business calendar lub trigger blokuje; ręczna data nie jest automatycznym ustawowym terminem.
HG-04 current; każda pozycja/Request/Argument mapped i HUMAN-approved; zmiana unieważnia dalsze decyzje.

HG-06 exact reviewed plan; Section allowlist, required inputs, no new facts/rules; public Stage08 operations only.
Provider untrusted, all statements traceable; prompt/model/generator/parameters/raw output pinned; rejected output cannot persist a trusted draft.
Conformance fixture separately from real pinned local model; mismatch/timeout/malformed/offline fail closed; exact model-byte-use ceiling explicit; no privacy leak.
HG-07 all seven assessments exact draft/hash/snapshot/policy/date; semantic truth not asserted by machine.
HG-08 if used; complete twelve PASS, no ERROR/BLOCKER/CRITICAL; UNKNOWN/NOT_RUN/FAIL blocks; fresh runs after remediation.
Public authorized host loads current trusted records/validation, derives SemanticDocument/RenderRequest, prevents caller PASS/authority injection.
Actual exact bytes + receipt + metadata stored atomically/recoverably; validated formats, polish glyphs, contents and attachment list; render PASS repository-derived; no watermark.
HG-09 current HUMAN approval targets exact draft/snapshot/DOCX/PDF and bound run; revocation/tamper drift blocks; public endpoint audited, CAS/replay safe.

requirements.goal: Public release and durable FINAL receipt
requirements.definition_of_done: Authorized repository-loaded release produces immutable receipt only after all gates; FINAL eligibility distinct from Draft.status and Filing.status; legacy bypass remains denied.

All ten members schema/version/hash/length bound; maps resolve; read after restart; package not FINAL on missing/corrupt member. Pełny assembler końcowo łączy także późniejszy zakres katalogu/UX; PB02 nie ma budować całego dalszego programu.
Audit hash chain + domain/object/command pins cover accepted inputs through package; privacy-preserving; verified read-only audit not mistaken for a full bundle.
Public render/approval/release/package and existing stages have actor-bound replay, exact CAS, conflict/no partial FINAL, concurrent stale/race/restart coverage on real PG.
HG-10 distinct builder/verifier/promoter; clean exact candidate SHA CI zero skip and independent technical + legal/type review; promoter approval recorded; no Stage14/ROS dependency.

HUMAN akceptuje chronologię source-bound dates i rozbieżności dla każdego typu; daty zdarzeń nie zastępowane received_at/recorded_at. Dedykowany automatyczny Timeline engine nie jest obietnicą tego baseline.
